turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Sure! Let me show you one first.
I work in an office. My friend works in a shop. My friend is one person, like he or she, so I add -s to work.
The rule: after he, she or it (one person or thing), add -s to the verb.
She reads every evening is right. She read every evening is wrong.

Now you try. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
